name: Jimmy's Barber Shop
address: 92 Haverstock Hill, Belsize Park, London NW3 2BD
ratingNote: 4.8 from 81 reviews via Chamber of Commerce UK directory aggregating Google reviews. Live Maps scrape blocked in this environment — treat as directory-confirmed Google aggregate.

reviews.quote: Quality barber. No fuss, efficient and very tidy job. Good conversation too.
reviews.author: Harry Clements

reviews.quote: Very quality haircut, cheap prices, superb service! Will definitely come back. Thanks Jimmy!
reviews.author: Alex T

reviews.quote: Jimmy's always a good chat and is really knowledgeable on all things hair. He really listens to what you're after, rather than trying to convince you a style would look good on you. Consistent and great quality cuts have me returning time and again.
reviews.author: S. V.

reviews.quote: Jimmy has been cutting my hair for 25 years and I can honestly say this is the best barber shop in the world!!
reviews.author: H. H.

reviews.quote: Just moved into London… Jimmy was nice, courteous and welcoming. He immediately understood what I wanted and gave me a great cut, while also explaining what he was doing technically. Will definitely come back.
reviews.author: M. G.

reviews.quote: Finally found a barber who listens to his customers offering genuine advice and a great cut at a brilliant price. Jimmy is now my regular barber.
reviews.author: V. H.

reviews.quote: Jimmy is great. And before you ask, he doesn’t even know how google works, so these reviews are all just from genuine people who love his haircuts!
reviews.author: J. W.

reviews.quote: Update: Been coming here for over 10 years… Fast affordable and professional, haven't had a bad cut over several years. Very amicable man, worth it for the conversation alone!
reviews.author: Local regular
